planSteps.description: Switch role to 'ตั้งค่าร้าน (Store Settings)' from the role switcher
Settings form displays fields for Store Name (TH/EN), PromptPay Number, Account Name, Business Hours, Table Capacity, and Tax ID
Scroll to the 'Staff Permissions' and 'System Reset' section at the bottom
Danger zone card displays 'รีเซ็ตข้อมูลระบบ (Reset System Data)' button with warning notes
Click 'รีเซ็ตข้อมูลระบบ' button
Confirm modal pops up asking for confirmation before wiping test data
Click 'ยกเลิก (Cancel)' in the confirm modal
Modal dismisses safely without altering store configuration
